canonical_data: a virtual filesystem of memories, resources, and skills in tiered summaries over a local vector index and file store
current_repo_note: The repository open-sources a subset of the capabilities described in the vendor's published paper; the commercial self-managed edition is activated by a license key whose code is not in this repository. The bundled agent module is a port of the separately published nanobot runtime.
strengths: Every query keeps the directory-browsing path that produced it, so a wrong result can be traced rather than attributed to an opaque similarity score
Client surfaces are deliberately permissive while the server stays copyleft, so an embedder can link the command line and TypeScript library without that reaching their own code
Runs offline in earnest, with local vector and file backends and an installer that detects and provisions a local model runtime
weaknesses: The Python library declares no license and so inherits the copyleft root, while its Go and TypeScript siblings are permissive
Every published benchmark figure is vendor-run on the vendor's own model and embeddings, at a version older than the current tree
The repository is less than eight months old and calls itself early stage, so its adoption implies more operational history than exists
why_it_matters: Reframes agent memory as a browsable filesystem with tiered summaries rather than an opaque vector store, and already drops into a third-party runtime as an alternative to an established service.
